newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A rating to Hyakugo Bank.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A rating to Hyakugo Bank.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had assigned an A long-term counterparty rating and an A-1 short-term counterparty rating to Hyakugo Bank Ltd.
The rating outlook is stable, S&P said in a statement.
The ratings are based on the bank's sound asset quality, solid capitalisation and adequate profitability, S&P said.
The ratings also reflect its strong liquidity, backed by Hyakugo's dominant market position in Mie prefecture, central Japan, S&P said.

Hyakugo has avoided asset-quality problems that are wide spread in Japan's banking sector, owing to its diversified loan portfolio and limited expansion into risky sectors in the Tokyo and Osaka metropolitan areas, S&P said.
Those strengths mostly mitigated negative factors such as Hyakugo's limited business and geographic diversification, which could make it difficult to increase revenues, S&P said.
